summary: CenterPoint Energy filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a fixed-to-fixed reset rate junior subordinated notes offering due 2058. The notes bear a fixed rate until August 2033, then reset to the Five-Year Treasury Rate plus a spread. Terms, including aggregate principal, initial rate, spread, and underwriting discount, are left blank in the preliminary filing. The issuer may defer interest for up to 20 consecutive periods and may redeem before maturity. Notes are unsecured and subordinated. Joint book-running managers include Mizuho, PNC, Scotiabank, TD Securities, and others. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation.
